title: $1,000 in each since 2010: who wins?
caption:
Famous brands race since 2010? $1,000 in each in 2010.
Winner: Starbucks, now about {growth:SBUX:2010-01-04}.
Last: Nike, about {growth:NKE:2010-01-04}.
